seed_memories.content: recall_fast is the proxy-mode entry point: it calls recall_temporal with fast=true, which skips Supermemory cross-validation, query expansion, and the LLM reranker, keeping latency around 50-100ms for hot prompts.
Travel reminder to mail the postcards from the museum gift shop before checking out on Sunday morning.
Notes from the carpentry workshop: a Japanese pull saw cuts on the back stroke, leaves a cleaner kerf than a Western push saw on thin stock.
Plant care log: the fiddle leaf fig finally pushed out a new leaf after I moved it closer to the south window.
